description: A vault's reveal and copy, the two commands that put a secret's value where the window can reach it, granted to charter's own windows — the main window and the split windows a project tab is moved into — and to nothing else (ADR 0052, amended 2026-09-26). A split window can have a vault's tab in front, so it is granted what the main window is and no more. A capability of its own so that no window added to `default` later inherits them. `src/ipc.rs` fails if any other capability grants them, or if this one reaches past charter's own windows.
